definitions.accounting: Order quantities and allocated budget/margin/other amounts are accounting descriptions, not independent causal price contributions.
definitions.count_overlap: Budget, margin and other component event counts can overlap; only shares and notional components are additive.
definitions.agent_ids: Zero-based population array indices within each seed, not stable identities across seeds.
definitions.excess_count: Per-agent long max(h-L,0) and short max(-L-h,0), counted when excess shares exceed 1e-9; raw small positive shares/notionals retained.
definitions.valuation: Opening, after_budget and after_fill_decision_limit use opening price and decision-time limits; closing uses closing price and recomputed limits.
definitions.orders: Before_constraint/after_direction/after_budget/after_risk notionals use opening price; filled uses execution price.
definitions.exposure: Gross/net are sums of individual holdings, not netted excess; gross/aggregate limit below 1 does not establish every agent respects limits.
definitions.quantiles: Per-agent time-average excess quantiles are calculated within each seed, then summarized across 20 seeds; not pooled quantiles.
definitions.duration: Consecutive per-agent excess runs are reset at the burn-in boundary and censored at evaluation end.
definitions.wealth: Reported value wealth is aggregate cash plus marked-to-close holdings; target gap is absolute desired-minus-filled holdings at close.
definitions.pair_sign: Every delta is D minus the same-seed reference; negative counts use absolute tolerance 1e-9.

findings: 加入预算控制明显压缩了B的持续多头超限：成交后按原价/原限额的日均超额金额由180939.515728降至D的7.636041，20个种子中16个下降、4个不变；最长单主体连续超限由2500日降至1日。
D没有实现每个时点零超限。预算后仍有单主体峰值217.808358（seed 20261106，agent 3，day 3151），同日组合超额峰值82095.294561；开盘/收盘重估的日均超额分别1993.241424/1996.425696，最长连续11日。预算后的1日残余与单日最大调仓约束相容，不能用很小的均值掩盖峰值。
C仅预算已将成交后日均超额降至6.927375、最长1日。D相对C该超额均值增加0.708666（5个种子增加、1个减少、14个不变）；D的目标缺口在20/20种子均更大，平均增加25085.010852。D相对C期末价值主体财富平均增加4485.105377，但仅12/20增加，8/20减少，不能判断D全面优于C。
D相对B期末价值主体财富平均减少359541.083292（12降/4平/4升），平均gross持仓减少188816.801260；相对A期末财富平均减少133300.464078（15降/5升）。风险约束、暴露、目标跟踪与财富应同时解释。
D全部20种子合计的正价值信号卖出成交量308300.633735股、金额96025703.563331均归为budget；负价值信号买入411.957384股、金额60641.297521均归为margin，集中在seed 20261112的2823个主体日；settlement追加补仓为0。上述为数量记账分配，不是独立价格因果贡献，组件事件计数不可加。
80次开发运行中，价值型主体在四个估值时点均没有空头预算超限。报告对称计算了长短两侧，但该开发样本没有充分触发空头预算纠偏；不能把零计数等同于该分支的经验压力验收。
本分析逐日订单金额核对最大残差为0，逆向数量分解核对无异常，工程问题清单为空。它仍是开发期暴露分析，不改变第一阶段正式验收门槛或第二阶段准入。
